verdict.rationale: An official LangSmith MCP server is documented, and the docs state traces can be filtered and exported via the API, so an agent can query trace data programmatically. The evidence does not show what the MCP server exposes, or that metrics, dashboards or eval and experiment results can be queried through the API or MCP. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage, API or MCP access to metrics and eval results, no OpenAPI spec found, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
